integrity: Reproducible exact-integer Laplacian calculation and independent exhaustive C++ tour enumeration included; no independent mathematical audit claimed.
mathematical_scope: All rotations of binary length-54 words containing every primitive six-mer exactly once; additional complement and reversal operations on rotation classes.
scientific_limitations: Only length-six windows; no general formula for higher orders. Complete enumeration of fixed-orbit classes relies on explicit finite matrix tree cofactors and a separately exhaustive tour calculation. The priority search is best-knowledge rather than definitive.
title: Complete complement–reversal census of primitive binary six-window universal cycles
